Key points
The objectives of this article are to describe:
• Origins and deﬁnition of the term ‘stunting’, and its use as an indicator of child health and nutrition
• Global and regional burden of stunting and secular trends
• Consequences of stunting in early childhood
• Risk factors for stunting
• Nutrition-speciﬁc and nutrition-sensitive interventions to reduce the burden of stunting
